IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Finance (originally sponsored by Representatives Grant, Walsh, Haler, and Linville)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning tax incentives for certain polysilicon manufacturers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax credit forqualified preproduction development expenditures for polysiliconmanufacturers; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the welfare ofthe people of the state of Washington is positively impacted throughthe encouragement and expansion of family wage employment in thestate's manufacturing industries. The legislature further finds thattargeting tax incentives on high technology industries is an importantbusiness climate strategy. The legislature further finds that thesolar panel industry has experienced a growth rate of almost fortypercent per year over the past five years. The legislature furtherfinds that a material, known as polysilicon, is a primary material usedin solar panels. It is the intent of the legislature to encouragefamily wage employment in the state's manufacturing industries byproviding tax incentives related to the manufacture of polysilicon foruse in solar panels.
